correctness.rationale: Locality at z forces center preservation. A derivation has arbitrary central functional and quotient block B satisfying B^t J+JB=lambda J with the SAME lambda as its central action. diag(lambda I,0) supplies every lambda without dividing by two. Independently, for a nonzero v and desired image w, choose l(v)=1 and alpha=omega(w,-); the symmetric form l(x)alpha(y)+alpha(x)l(y)-alpha(v)l(x)l(y) equals alpha(y) at x=v, and omega(Sx,y) equal to this form defines S in sp with Sv=w, also in characteristic two. This gives the needed pointwise match. Symmetric forms have dimension n(2n+1); adding 2n+1 gives the ordinary dimension, whereas every quotient endomorphism is allowed locally. The dimension difference is n(2n-1), so the finite counts and ratio follow. Independently checked evaluation ranks and derivation constraint ranks over F2, F3, F4 and F5 (python3 /workspace/reproduction/1.py; output 1.txt in that directory); exhaustive rank-one map checks over F2 and F3 also gave (64,128) and (729,2187) for (ordinary,local). The proof, not the bounded computations, establishes the all-field equality.
